ns2:course.label: Hum Comp Interaction Lab
ns2:course.description: Examines basic concepts, methodology, and critical skills needed in conducting research, evaluating and designing human-computer interfaces. Laboratory includes performing experiments in human-computer interaction. Same as AVI 429, and IE 446. Prerequisite: PSYC 224, PSYC 358, or PSYC 456; and a course in computer science; or consent of instructor.
